tags.portraits: Portrait subjects; not restricted to a location.
tags.environmental_portrait: A portrait including the surrounding environment.
tags.subject_in_context: A subject shown with its surrounding setting.
tags.contextual_detail: A close subject or surface with readable surroundings.
tags.landscape_context: Landscape present as context for another subject; distinct from the landscapes topic.
tags.animals: Animal subjects within a habitat or domestic setting.
tags.landscapes: Landscape as the primary subject; distinct from landscape_context.
tags.interior: An indoor setting; independent of the primary subject.
tags.art: Physical artworks shown in their environment.
tags.artwork_in_context: The whole physical artwork in its display setting.
tags.details: Surfaces, textures and small details as subjects.

notes: Legacy paesaggio is contextual; paesaggi is a topic. These remain distinct.
Canonical aliases are rejected in records; normalize explicitly before admission.
Extend this versioned vocabulary explicitly for new tags; do not silently invent synonyms.
